column2: You don't seem as stupid as you look!!
Ha ha ha! Glad you get it! ...Wait, hey!!
Forgive me... for having you open my cell as well...
A $$大神官$$ among the noble folk with black $$羽$$, a holy necromancer, and a grand master of $$魔道$$!!
If you're the real thing, why didn't you use magic!?
Well, it is quite embarrassing, but... without corpses, we cannot use magic.
After all, magic needs an enormous amount of $$血$$ from $$生けにえ$$s as its catalyst...!
And those bastards took my $$魔道$$ staff as well!!
(Perhaps, somewhere along the way, I had forgotten...)
(is a ship now sinking into the abyss...)
(rather than sit and wait to die...)
(we should dare to pull chestnuts from the fire...)
More importantly, we must get out of here at once,
or our pursuers will be here soon!
